subject: Acme pilot demo — aligning with CTO transit window and exec coverage
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@acme.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <acme-procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2025-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Acme pilot demo — confirm exec attendance

Hi David and Monica,

Thanks again for setting up the pilot demo. We're confirmed for July 2 at 10:00 AM PT in the calendar invite, and the team is very much looking forward to it. A quick ask — our CTO (Jasper Lin) is traveling and his ETA into SFO is tight on the morning of the 2nd (flight lands 9:50 AM). He indicated he will try to join for the tail end of the executive Q&A but can't commit to the whole session. The VP (Maya Chen) is flexible and can cover the exec portion if Jasper can't stay.

Two requests: can you confirm whether 10:00 AM still gives us enough buffer for Jasper to join, or if a small shift (to 11:00 AM) would be preferable so the CTO can attend? Also, can you send an updated agenda/attachment that highlights the executive touchpoints so Maya can step in smoothly if needed? I've attached our travel itinerary for context.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Park
Senior Product Manager, Acme Systems
elena@acme.com

Attachment: travel-itinerary.pdf (1 page)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme pilot demo — confirm exec attendance

Elena — thanks for the heads up and the itinerary. Appreciate the detail.

We initially set 10:00 AM PT to accommodate both technical and exec walk-throughs, but given Jasper's landing time that morning 11:00 AM PT looks safer to ensure he can join live for Q&A. If you'd prefer to keep 10:00 and have Maya cover the exec portion, we can do that as well.

I'm attaching an updated agenda (demo-agenda-v2.pdf) that flags the 15-minute executive Q&A at the end so Maya can step in without interruption. If you confirm 11:00, I'll send an updated calendar invite and note the CTO's transit constraints so we have a backup plan.

-David
David Kim
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.com

Attachment: demo-agenda-v2.pdf (2 pages)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-30T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme pilot demo — confirm exec attendance

David / Monica — quick note: I prefer we keep the meeting within the originally scheduled day (no cancellations). If Jasper can only make the tail end, that's OK — we should plan the session so product and technical content run first and exec Q&A is at the end.

Action items:
- David: propose a single new start time (11:00 AM PT) and update the invite if Elena confirms.
- Monica: prepare a 5-minute bridge script for Maya so she can jump in seamlessly if needed.

Keep it tight. Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales — Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Park <elena@acme.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Acme Procurement <acme-procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2025-07-01T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme pilot demo — confirm exec attendance

On Mon, Jun 30, 2025 at 10:05 AM David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com> wrote:
> Elena — thanks for the heads up and the itinerary. Appreciate the detail.
>
> We initially set 10:00 AM PT to accommodate both technical and exec walk-throughs, but given Jasper's landing time that morning 11:00 AM PT looks safer to ensure he can join live for Q&A. If you'd prefer to keep 10:00 and have Maya cover the exec portion, we can do that as well.

Thanks — 11:00 AM PT works for us and gives Jasper a bit more breathing room. We'll keep Maya on standby as the backup. Please go ahead and push the invite to 11:00 and include the updated agenda. Also can you add a short note in the calendar description indicating Jasper's potential late arrival so our internal team is aware and prepared to signal a handoff if needed.

Best,
Elena

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-01T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme pilot demo — confirm exec attendance

Elena — perfect, thanks for confirming. I've updated the calendar to July 2, 11:00 AM — new invite sent (replaces 10:00 AM instance). Notes added to the event: "CTO Jasper Lin (ETA 9:50 AM) may join late; VP Maya Chen standing by to cover exec Q&A if needed."

Attached is the final agenda with exec cues highlighted. Monica — please have the 2-minute handoff script ready and flag any slides that require handover so Maya can jump in mid-stream without context loss.

See you on the 2nd.

-David
David Kim
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: demo-agenda-v2.pdf (final), calendar-update.ics (event update)
